# Wards and boroughs

[UDMA notification 1728](https://udma.wb.gov.in/uploads/circular_pdf/1790762626_1728orderma_.pdf), published in the Kolkata Gazette on 11 September 2026, replaces Schedule II of the Kolkata Municipal Corporation Act, 1980. It lists the boundaries of 209 wards, up from 144 under the previous schedule. The [KMC notice board](https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KMCPortalHome1.jsp) lists the final notification separately from the draft and invitation for objections.

[The Week reported on 13 November](https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2026/11/13/calcutta-hc-moved-over-howrah-municipal-corporation-ward-delimitation-after-kmc-case.html) that the Calcutta High Court had stayed the KMC election process pending the delimitation hearing. On 20 November, [The Telegraph reported](https://news.google.?oc=5) that the Supreme Court would hear the election pleas on 23 November. As of 22 November, 209 is the gazetted count, not a count of elected councillors.

KMC's [basic statistics](https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/BasicStatistics.jsp) describe the earlier 144 wards in 16 boroughs and give a municipal area of 206.08 square kilometres. A ward is an electoral constituency; a borough groups wards for administration. Use [Know Your Ward](https://kmc.wb.gov.in/contact-us/knowYourWard) for the municipal directory. Before using a directory ward number as a September 2026 reference, match the street to the boundary in notification 1728.

KMC's [contact directory](https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KmcContact.jsp) links separately to councillors, borough committees and borough offices. For birth registration, its [office list](https://www.kmcgov.in/KMCPortal/jsp/KMCBirth.jsp) places Borough I at 10 B.T. Road, Cossipore, Borough X at 217 Prince Anwar Shah Road and Borough XVI at Diamond Park, Joka.
